title: A new whitefish skinner to meet modern processing needs
summary: There are three things that reveal how the Curio Skinner is designed differently to other skinners, safety, accessibility, and reliability .
body_markdown:
Accessibility is key to the thorough cleaning of fish processing equipment that ensures hygiene standards are met, and safe products are being made. The new Curio Skinner has rethought traditional design to make all parts of the machine more accessible. Maintaining the highest hygiene standards is easier, and more efficient thanks to:


- Wide openings
- Conveyor belts fold in to make cleaning and maintenance access easy
- Chamfered steel surfaces to prevent residue from water, dirt, or cleaning agents collecting
- Sealed panels to prevent dirt entering the machine housing
- Solid construction to handle the harsh washdown environment of a busy fish processing facility
